gloss: sacred place; holy site; spiritual ground

definitions.gloss: sacred place; holy site; spiritual ground
definitions.explanation: A place considered to have spiritual significance or divine power, often associated with shrines, temples, or natural sites believed to house deities or spirits.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{霊地|れいち}だ。
examples.english: This mountain has been a sacred place since ancient times.

examples.japanese: {霊地|れいち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I set out on a journey visiting sacred places.

examples.japanese: {熊野|くまの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{霊地|れいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ひとつで、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巡礼者|じゅんれいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: Kumano is one of Japan's most renowned sacred places, and many pilgrims visit there.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{霊|れい}→霊：14667_rei⟧ (spirit, soul) + {地|ち} (place, ground). Refers to locations believed to have spiritual power or divine significance in Shinto, Buddhism, or folk religion.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has many famous {霊地|れいち}, including mountain peaks, ancient forests, waterfalls, and temple/shrine complexes. These are often destinations for pilgrimage (⟦{巡礼|じゅんれい}→巡礼：10662_junrei⟧) and spiritual practice (⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧). Examples include {高野山|こうやさん}, {熊野|くまの}, and {出羽三山|でわさんざん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {霊地|れいち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧: to visit sacred places
- {霊地|れいち}⟦{巡礼|じゅんれい}→巡礼：10662_junrei⟧: pilgrimage to sacred places
- {古|いにしえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{霊地|れいち}: an ancient holy site

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{聖地|せいち}→聖地：18255_seichi⟧: holy land, sacred place — often used for both religious and secular "mecca" (e.g., anime pilgrimage sites)
- ⟦{霊場|れいじょう}→霊場：14866_reijou⟧: sacred place of worship — specifically a pilgrimage site, often part of a numbered circuit
- {霊山|れいざん}: sacred mountain
